name: Thermostat / TRV
description: Actuating heating / cooling controllers — thermostatic radiator valves, smart thermostats, and boiler controllers — that report a target setpoint and/or valve position alongside the measured temperature.
notes: hvac.setpoint is °C, hvac.valvePosition is %. The measured room temperature, when present, is air.temperature. A passive temperature + humidity sensor with no actuation is `climate`, not this.
